note: What a server sends to change what a client draws for a unit on its map. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: changeIcon
fields.note: 1 to replace the unit's minimap icon with icon; 0 leaves it, icon unread.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: The name the client loads the mark under. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: changeBorder
fields.note: 1 to replace the unit's ring with border, and what it does with borderScript; 0 leaves both, neither read.

fields.name: border
fields.note: The name the client loads the ring around the mark under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: borderScript
fields.note: The name the client loads the ring's own doings under, written and padded as above.

revisions.note: A client does nothing unless unit is a unit it holds that can be attacked.

bits.name: change
bits.note: Set where the mark below replaces what the client draws.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: The name the client loads the mark under. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

bits.name: change
bits.note: Set where the ring below replaces what the client draws.

fields.name: border
fields.note: The name the client loads the ring around the mark under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: borderScript
fields.note: The name the client loads the ring's own doings under, written and padded as above.
